stackDivergence.rationale: Native owner boundaries, complete token/namespace identities and original factory generators are retained. Browser maps, immutable lexical URI strings and byte arrays bind generated gperf/UTF8/component transport; actual existing OOXMLValue/UNO/RTL/SAX owners provide typed conversions and model dispatch.

preservedResponsibilities: Original sorted-alias one-based shifted16 namespace identities, exact transitional/strict URI maps, separate per-instance map ownership and shared singleton. Canonical raw inputs remain byte-exact to native files and are checked against unchanged namespaces.py output. Host immutable URI strings bind the SAX boundary; native OUString storage, thread synchronization and ABI remain omitted.

Actual map values now own native OUString objects constructed from the unchanged generated ASCII URI declarations. Literal byte carriers bind the declared char-array overload in the current realm. Source std::map destruction is explicit; static singleton remains realm-owned. Native string equality and returned copies replace host object/string comparisons. Every original generated ID/URI input and both TokenmapTest round-trip loops remain exercised. Borrowed map data/retained copies survive destruction of independent map owners. Physical std::map ABI, complete copy/move special members and realm shutdown remain unqualified.
Combines the original NMSP and XML token identities independently of Writer factory initialization.
omittedResponsibilities: Unconsumed native interfaces, component services, C++ ABI and native memory/thread/performance contracts remain outside this consumed binding.
Document/style/list/table/section/theme SAX contexts, complete canonical DOCX model import/export and existing UI integration remain pending in V4DQJW.
